sample_list_item.name: excluded-users-from-soft-remediation
sample_list_item.description:
This list allows you to exclude trusted and critical users from **User Soft Remediation** commands such as expiring passwords or other commands that address security issues without completely locking or disabling a user's account. After these commands are run, a user can regain access through steps such as two-factor authentication.
Fields supported: id, username, email.
Include all relevant identifiers used across systems.
Example: "username1, user@compamy.com, userID112, username2"
